parameter_provenance.V0: Section III.D, page 063605-6: 15.40 +/-0.45 cm3/mol of FeS; multiply both value and error by Z*1e24/NA, with Z=4 and exact SI NA.
parameter_provenance.K0: Section III.D: 115.5 +/-27.91 GPa, fitted to Sata (2008) and Ohfuji (2007) cold observations.
parameter_provenance.theta0: Section III.D, page 063605-7: fixed 417 K, adopted hcp-Fe value from Dewaele et al. (2006).
parameter_provenance.gamma0: Section III.D: 2.42 +/-0.03, sole refined thermal coefficient.
parameter_provenance.n: Two atoms per FeS formula unit; Z=4 handled by the public-to-molar volume conversion, not by changing n to 8.
parameter_provenance.determination_method: Experimental cold compression and LH-DAC PVT fits; fixed Debye temperature adopted from measured hcp-Fe EOS, fixed q is an analytical model choice. Section III.D.
parameter_provenance.debye_temperature_law: Full integrated MGD confirmed for the supplied March 2024 FeS6.eos (Thermal=7, Param14=0, q=1). The printed source coefficients and 300 K reference are retained; the supplied author-used file has different V0, gamma0 and Tref. The user confirms these are the complete author-used inputs; staged parameter agreement within reported uncertainties is accepted, while exact author-workflow reproduction remains unverified.

superseded_record_text.notes: One published common volume relation fitted across FeS-VI, IV and IX. This card supplies a FeS-VI Pnma diffraction structure only; it does not supply IV/IX coordinates, phase transitions, anisotropic thermal expansion or a stability map. The structural cell is measured at 56 GPa/300 K and is distinct from extrapolated EOS V0. Reported parameter errors have unspecified confidence and no covariance. Accepted on staged parameter agreement within reported uncertainties. The residual-envelope discrepancy is informational; exact author workflow is unverified. Use the common EOS within the paper's 40-150 GPa scope and observed thermal coverage; this is not a phase-stability guarantee.
